en: Black‑and‑white riverfront view of a European town. In the foreground a paddle steamer with passengers moves along a wide river, with barges and small boats moored near a quay. On the right bank stand 19th‑century townhouses and villas, behind a high embankment wall and promenade. Rising on the hill above the town is a large hilltop complex of fortified buildings and towers that looks like a castle or former monastery dominating the skyline. The surrounding landscape is hilly and partly wooded. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image side.
